content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing an issue with my [product_name] web server: the HR meter is showing values in minutes even though it's supposed to display hours. I suspect I need to divide the value by 60, but can't find a suitable mathematical function for this purpose. Any suggestions would be greatly appreciated.
Welcome to the forum. Try using the scaled time display feature.
Thank you for your suggestion—using the scaled time display solved my issue!

analysis.insight_summary: The user noticed that the HR meter on the [product_name] web server was incorrectly showing data in minutes instead of hours, due to limited conversion functions. By following advice to use the scaled time display, the user successfully addressed the issue, though this solution may not be immediately obvious to others.
analysis.user_expectations: The user would like the HR meter to reliably display values in hours as configured, along with straightforward or easily available functions for basic unit conversion on the web server.
